resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county table's height column reads 85, while a 1977 survey note says about 60 feet. No height is recorded in facts; the story reports both figures.

notes_for_editor: Only the county table gives history: a 1929 date, ladder type, owner code Mn MFS, a 1977 height note and the communication tower at the site. The Central US page gives name, county and the 57N-21W-36 reference only. The FFLA list says gone. Two searches found no other Maple Hill record in Minnesota; a Maple Hill fire tower in Pennsylvania came up but is unrelated. No staffing, fire, access or photo was found, so access is not recorded. The 1929 date is from one table and is not confirmed.
